page.title: Theme
page.intro: Choose the colors, shapes and font of the app. Labels like tier headers, chains and the report button always stay readable, so a theme that would make them hard to read can't be saved.

preset.default: App default (follows your device's light or dark mode)

type.sizeHelp: The accessibility text size in Display settings takes priority over this.

preview.label: Preview
preview.author: alex
preview.body: This is how a post reads with this theme.
preview.muted: Secondary text, like times and counts.

errors.theme_contrast: {check, select, integrity {Labels like tier headers and the report button would be too hard to read. errors.theme_invalid: This theme has a value that isn't allowed.
errors.rate_limited: You've changed your theme a lot today. Try again later.

advanced.intro: Theme CSS looks like CSS, but it can only style named parts of the app (cards, buttons, the page background…) with a fixed set of properties, and it can only use images you upload here. It never touches tier headers, chains, the report button or other labels, and it doesn't apply on sign-in, recovery, settings or moderation pages, so you can always come back here to undo it.
advanced.placeholder: like '{' background-image: image(heart); label: hidden; min-inline-size: 40px; '}'
advanced.parts: Parts you can style (one per selector, separated by commas):
advanced.states: States you can add after a part, like button:hover:
advanced.props: Properties you can set. Colors are hex like #6b2fd6. label: hidden replaces a button's text with its image (screen readers still read the text).
advanced.example: Example: like:pressed '{' background-image: image(heart-full); label: hidden; '}'
advanced.imagesOff: Image uploads are off on this server, so theme CSS can't use images right now.
advanced.imageName: Image name (lowercase letters, digits and dashes)
advanced.imageNameBad: Use a name that starts with a letter and has only lowercase letters, digits and dashes.
advanced.imageNameTaken: This theme already has an image with that name.
advanced.imagesFull: A theme can have up to 8 images.
